description: Explain a cubicle.script v1 as the runner compiled it: its kind (strategy or indicator), inputs with bounds, fields with their types, states, what it draws and its budget, every order (the transition it sits on, where it fills: close, next_open, limit(<price>) or stop(<price>), its stop, target and trail), the fill model it declares, and the same in plain lines to say to the trader. Or pass `code` (C050) for what one diagnostic code means. Nothing runs. Free.

code.description: a diagnostic code to explain instead, such as C050

name: script_explain
